description: This file defines the security configuration for the promotions-service, specifically configuring Spring Security to act as an OAuth2 Resource Server validating JWT tokens issued by Keycloak. It permits unauthenticated access to certain endpoints such as actuator health checks and API documentation, while securing other endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security filters, including OAuth2 JWT validation and access rules for the promotions-service.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, disabling CSRF, setting authorization rules for specific URL patterns, and configuring OAuth2 resource server with JWT support.
